title: Deductive Chains and the Ethical Dialogue Essay
goal: Connect premises to conclusions using deductive luego, de ahí que + subjunctive, and de modo que, and read a philosophical dialogue essay.
grammar: deductive luego, de ahí que + subjunctive, mid-clause por consiguiente, and de modo que (indicative vs subjunctive)

items: I can use deductive luego and de ahí que + subjunctive to link ethical premises to logical conclusions.
I can contrast de modo que + indicative (result) with de modo que + subjunctive (normative aim).
I can follow a philosophical dialogue essay debating duty versus consequences through a concrete dilemma.
